findings: Every sampled offset uses that profile executable and its actual linked native Object.
Explicit stack loads/stores, rank arithmetic, comparisons and register moves remain observed.
The before/after native function inventory differs; no earlier mapping or source-versus-bookkeeping split is assumed.
limitations: Current-PC samples are statistical positions, not dynamic instruction counts or CPU-time shares.
Static counts include cold error paths.
A source location alone does not identify a spill or move as useful arithmetic or bookkeeping.
